interface.longDescription: HolyCodex provides native Codex subagent profiles, bounded specialist skills, and deterministic verification for Codex tasks.
defaultPrompt: Use HolyCodex as Root: delegate every task, including trivial work, through a bounded Assignment and native specialist; retain intent, material decisions, lifecycle, integration, approvals, VCS, and completion.

Direct Root execution is limited to Git/VCS, plus Computer Use only when installed with --computer-use. Require Reviewer.code fixed-point review before completion or VCS, then delegate exact-ref/SHA terminal CI or release observation and repeat repair until green.

Use request_user_input before plan approval, remote/origin/server VCS mutation, or whenever material ambiguity blocks safe progress; apply the repository surgical-mutation rule and persist needs_root_input.
